clauses.clause: When this creature enters, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: ask target: [opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant, opp_relic, opp_charm] (not opp_land, a Forest, and none of yours); each choice moves that permanent to the graveyard (by card/DESTROY); fires again entering from hand on the opponent's turn; no trigger when another creature enters; cost W-7.
